verdict.stance: Overweight / Oman Sovereign Proxy with 19.66% CAR (BBB- / Baa3)
verdict.summary: Bank Muscat (~35%+ Oman banking market share) posted 9.2% YoY net profit growth to OMR 209.2m in 9M26 as assets reached OMR 16.0bn (+9.9%) and impairments fell 25%. Oman's return to IG (BBB-/Baa3) and a 19.66% Basel III CAR make the $750m 4.846% Oct-30 bond (XS3184474891) a high-quality GCC IG anchor.

positives: Dominant Omani systemic franchise (~19.66% CAR) aligned with Oman's IG sovereign upgrade.
9M26 net profit +9.2% YoY with impairments down 25% YoY.
Established Oman banking franchise with systemic liquidity access and regulatory oversight.
negatives: Hydrocarbon sensitivity of Oman sovereign and corporate borrowers.
Tight IG spread compression post-Oman rising-star upgrades.
Direct linkage to Oman sovereign credit ceiling, local policy rate cycles, and FX volatility.
